or 110-200 (230-330) |id = 8900 }} [[Cave horrors]] can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] starting at level 58 [[Slayer]] and 85 [[combat]] by [[Chaeldar]], [[Nieve]], [[Mortimer]], and [[Duradel]]. Cave horrors are found exclusively in the [[Mos Le'Harmless Cave]], requiring completion of [[Cabin Fever]]. You must wear a [[witchwood icon]] to fight cave horrors at melee distance, otherwise they will use a special attack which '''always''' deals damage equal to 10% of the player's base Hitpoints level, rounded down (e.g. 9 damage at 96). This can be completely mitigated by using [[Protect from Melee]], or using a safespot. A [[light source]] is also required to fight them without taking additional damage, unless a [[fire of eternal light]] is lit. Cave horrors attack with [[Magic-based melee]], meaning that [[Protect from Melee]] will negate the damage, but high magic defence will help when not praying. They have fairly low Hitpoints, and they are relatively spread apart, so it is generally best to use a fast-firing Ranged weapon like a [[toxic blowpipe]], [[magic shortbow (i)]], [[Hunters' sunlight crossbow]], or [[Karil's crossbow]]. If using Melee, it is recommended to use equipment that provides high [[Prayer]] bonus (such as [[Proselyte armour]]) and always use Protect from Melee so a better amulet can be used. A dwarf multicannon can also be used to speed up kills. Cave horrors can alternatively be safespotted by using the mushrooms, stalagmites, and boulders inside the cave, such as the area by the swamp near the cave entrance. Additionally, if using melee, it is helpful to bring a way to cast [[Bones to Peaches]] (or the [[Bones to peaches (tablet)|tablet version]]) as having good magic defence lets you out-heal their damage with the peaches. This can help save prayer potions and extend trips to the cave with extra healing. A [[herb sack]], [[seed box]], [[log basket]], and [[reagent pouch]] should be brought as well, as herbs, seeds, unnoted mahogany logs, and limpwurt roots are commonly dropped. ==Slayer Unlocks== By placing the cannon {{map|type=maplink|x:3785,y:9460|mapID=15|mtype=pin|group=cannon|text=here}} and standing on the location shown in the screenshot, horrors that are targeted by the cannon will never be able to attack you. This is due to the monster's [[pathfinding]] causing them to be stuck on the wall. There are two safe spots present in this image. The spot with the player standing in it currently is the safe spot for the horror closest to them. If there is no monster standing in that location, but there is a horror standing in the position of the second horror in the image, then moving south by a single tile will allow you to shoot the other horror, while still in relative safety. However, this secondary safe spot is much less reliable. If you want to let the cannon do all the work, without attacking at all, standing exactly two squares diagonally to the north-west of the spot with the player in the image (the middle of the three walkable squares with a black tile visible on it) will serve as a completely safe square, which can never be attacked by any monsters in the cave because of the blocking objects and walls around it. ===Gallery=== Below are some visual examples of areas where Cave horrors can be safespotted, but there are many more that are not shown throughout the cave, as there are many small obstacles and tight corridors. Any of the safespots farther in the cave require protect from melee or a Witchwood icon to safely reach, but can be a useful option if the entrance is already occupied by another player.
